calls.reason: Bloomberg and Reuters describe provisional plans but also report internal demonstrations. Without validation or evidence of promotional intent, they do not settle Zitron's evaluative characterization of the stories as hollow marketing.

WebAgent, GAIA and Anthropic's coding evaluation show related research, while WebArena shows substantial limitations. They do not establish comparable research projects at all three companies or a universal architectural cause.

The two theoretical papers support impossibility under specific assumptions; Nature documents partial mitigation and serious risks. This does not establish unrestricted impossibility or the opinion that hallucinations are the greatest danger.
